UP CEO Denies Conspiracy Over 'Missing' Hindu Voters After Yogi's Claim

Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) has stated that the Election Commission's database does not contain information on the religion or caste of voters, countering claims made by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Adityanath had flagged the issue of 'missing' Hindu voters, with some within the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) reportedly questioning how this occurred. The party has deployed RSS-linked organisational secretaries to oversee poll preparations across the state's six regions.
